query: IEEE C57.104 acetylene C2H2 few ppm high-energy arcing Bureau of Reclamation transformer diagnostics

results.query: IEEE C57.104 acetylene C2H2 few ppm high-energy arcing Bureau of Reclamation transformer diagnostics
results.snippet: If TDCG and individual gases are increasing significantly (more than 30 ppm per day [ppm/day]), an active fault is in progress. The transformer should be de-energized when Condition 4 levels are reached. A sudden increase in key gases and the rate of gas production is more important in evaluating a transformer than the accumulated amount of gas. One very important consideration is acetylene (C2H2). Generation of any amount of this gas above a few ppm indicates high-energy arcing.
results.title: FIST 3-31 Transformer Diagnostics (Bureau of Reclamation, June 2003), sec. 5.2 DGA caution and acetylene
